'''Wexell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial Military]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] he was wounded by revolting [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] in the [[Labor Valley]] and was forced to recuperate.<ref name="TOR" />
